_notes: Coordinates are L2J High Five datapack values; L2Toggle may differ (not checked live).

Castle NPCs = spawnlist NPCs inside the castle siege-zone polygon with a castle role (role ids from the datapack castle NPC scripts), castle doormen, artifacts, wyvern manager or a title equal to the castle name; role NPCs outside the polygon were looked up by id (see below).

npc roles: chamberlain, messenger (siege registration = CastleSiegeManager), gatekeeper (Mass Gatekeeper = CastleTeleporter), mercenary_manager, warehouse, court_wizard, blacksmith, dungeon_warden, doorman, wyvern_manager, other.
gates = doors.xml <prefix>_castle_* without _agit_ (agit = clan hall doors in the town). role from the name part (outter/inner/wall/side_door/small/station/ctr).
controlTowers (Life Control Tower 13002) and flameTowers (Flame Control Tower 13004, zoneIds = trap zones) from siege.properties.
Residence skills: pledgeSkillTree.xml residenceId = castle id; territorySkills: residenceId 80 + castle id (Territory Benefaction, clan level 5).
Siege schedule (SiegeSchedule.xml): Sunday 16:00 and 20:00, max 5 concurrent sieges; siege.properties SiegeHourList 16,20.
